## Projects

A home for the things I'm building around amateur radio — packet
infrastructure, machine learning for signal identification, SDR
experiments, and tools that make the underlying DSP visible.

Each project has its own page describing what it is, why I built it, where
it's at now, and links to related writing. Some are live services, others
are ongoing experiments and works in progress.
